structure: a tall vertical cutaway cross-section of a bright modern tech office building in the centre of a portrait canvas, with a giant magnifying glass leaning on its roof over a simple search bar shape.
character: young SEO intern (a white man in his early 20s, round glasses, short ginger hair, green hoodie, headphones round his neck)
scenes: he arrives with a coffee and checks a big monitor showing an abstract line chart going up.
he types into a laptop beside floating search bar shapes and a list of short abstract word blocks.
he edits a webpage mock-up on screen made of grey blocks, with small heading and image boxes highlighted.
he reads a spreadsheet of abstract coloured rows on two monitors, circling one row with a marker.
he presents a simple bar chart on a wall screen to two colleagues at a small table; dusk through the window.
props: a giant magnifying glass, chain links, an upward arrow, a trophy, a spider web made of lines, cogs, a rocket
